name: Shiosai no Serenade
original_name: しおさいのセレナード
source:
Spring-- The coastland town was bathed in the roar of the nearby sea.
Narahara Kyousuke waited for her on the train platform.
Her name was Yamakami Sakura. Kyousuke's childhood friend.
She'd been away for many years, but returned now to attend high school.
It was the first time home in five years.
Spring-- Kyousuke and Sakura's new friendship begins.

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE096924.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
春天——海边的小镇沐浴在附近大海的涛声中。奈良原恭介在火车站台上等待着她。她的名字叫山上樱。恭介的青梅竹马。她离开了多年，如今回来上高中。这是她五年来第一次回家。春天——恭介和樱的新友情开始了。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE096924.html]DLsite English[/url]]
